trajectory_summary: The call opens cold with real doubt about service area and legitimacy, dips into a stall attempt around the 2-minute mark, but the rep's no-commitment quote reframe recovers it and the call builds steadily through a long, patient bill-collection stretch into a booked appointment. Energy is mixed early then builds consistently once the quote-only framing lands.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Tuesday the 24th) and time (12:00) were both confirmed verbally by the customer, meeting the booked threshold; no co-owner was identified since she stated no one else is on the title.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: At 05:43 the rep repeats the bill range back ('Okay. So $1.50 to $2.50.') purely as data capture with no emotional reframe; the flip should have gone right there, tying the bill pain to the bill-swap pitch already given.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep did not ask why the customer was interested in solar; the customer asked about the offer but did not state a motivating reason the rep captured as an answer to an interest question.
